about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire first: for each of the four, the sha256 of the bytes served by https://lioreshai.github.io/breach-protocol-flash-next/ equals git show <build>:<file>, 4 for 4 - so the browser drew the build this tree ships, which is what makes these frames a property of the build and not of a harness (#388, #597).

Route: https://lioreshai.github.io/breach-protocol-flash-next/?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0, ONE page load per shot, ONE DEV.boot() per load, DEV.freeze(true), DEV.tick(30), then the pose below, DEV.tick(1), the game's own resume(), DEV.tick(1), S.mode read as "play" before the shutter (no pause overlay in the frame). Shutter = canvas.toDataURL on the display canvas, re-encoded to colour type 2 by tools/png_rgb.js (#394); the viewport is pinned to 1440x763 with Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride so the display canvas is the geometry every caption counts its 763 rows of. layout is state().layout == DEV.layoutSig() for this deal. sampleRate 44100 is this page's AudioContext measured, which is what says which machine this seed deals (#404). Pose: the same deal's derived arrival seat with NO DEV.cam (read back (18.5, 5.5), floorAt 0.00, heading 2.3562), then DEV.clear() and DEV.spawn("grunt", 1, 6), so the HUD reads 1 LEFT. DEV.lum({stride:97}) mean/mid = 66.99 / 79.96 (a stride-97 sample; the caption mean is the whole-frame luma tools/recap.js decodes). Canvas 1440x763, S.mode play, 1 hostiles left. No DEV.clear() on this shot, so the HUD counts the hostiles this deal seats. The frame it replaces is the PNG carried by origin/main at 174ec34, mean 59.7763 decoded from those bytes. This pass ran because #742 replaced the one-object-per-wall rule with the sector's own fitting about every 4 m, so the long-wall frames describe a picture that build did not draw.
